Chapter 7193: Saw The Future

Chapter 7193: Saw The Future

Li Qiye has finally arrived. His allies rejoiced at this moment.

“Sir, we’ve been waiting for you.” Phoenix Queen said with a smile.

“Who’s been waiting for who?” Li Qiye said.

“What do you think, Sir?” She spoke gently as if there were no enmity between them.

“I was waiting for you and Octopus.” Li Qiye said sentimentally: “But the high heaven was waiting for me.”

“Did you foresee this?” Octopus spoke in a strange language yet the meaning was conveyed with perfect clarity.

Octopus, Heavenfall, and Genesis all stood behind Phoenix Queen.

“Was hard not to foresee it. The villainous heaven knew this day would come.” Li Qiye said.

“Because ultimately, you will stand against the destruction of this world, so a generous gift has been prepared just for you.” Phoenix Queen said.

“Since the villainous heaven could cooperate with me to kill your group, it can also cooperate with you all to destroy the world.” Li Qiye said.

“That’s why Heaven Assault and Immortal Hunt became no more after Heaven Pit, only High Heaven Sect.” She said.

“Is it worth it? You once had the greatest love but now, you’re nothing, not Phoenix Queen who had loved your race, just an immortal living a borrowed life.” Li Qiye said.

The previous Phoenix Queen would have been agitated. However, this new one smiled and said: “Phoenix Queen had died after losing faith.”

“In the end, Skykiller True Dragon was right to forget you.” Li Qiye sighed and said: “This is a wavering dao heart, left with nothing.”

“Sir, it might be too soon to declare victory.” She said.

“You are confident?” Li Qiye asked.

“I know that we will still lose and you will kill us all. However, the high heaven destroy this world and then revive us, we will be the first ones in the brand new world, no different than the divine beasts.” She said.

“So that’s why you all choose to cooperate, hoping for revival.” Li Qiye nodded.

“If you can do it, the high heaven can as well, and it won’t be the first time.” She said.

“Messengers of destruction, I see.” Li Qiye smiled.

“High Heaven Sect exists for the high heaven.” She nodded: “Although the high heaven is outside of karma, karma will still be there. After we accomplish our tasks, we will earn the karma to live and enact justice.”

“I see, so the high heaven is now pragmatic, how interesting.” Li Qiye said.

“It is because of you, Sir, not even An Ran warranted this.” She said: “So it must kill you at all cost.”

“It is nothing more than a child panicking and throwing things around, unwilling to let adults come near.” Li Qiye chuckled.

“What?” She didn’t understand.

“You believe that high heaven will revive you all?” Li Qiye asked.

“The power of the high heaven defeated An Ran and will defeat you. We shall be eternal alongside it.” She said.

“I’ll have you know now that you all will die, the high heaven will cease to exist as well.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“We have placed our bet on your defeat.” She took a deep breath.

“Very well, watch and see if there is a second chance after this death.” Li Qiye said.

“It is not us who you will face, we only seek the destruction of this world.” She said.

“Sir, you must get through me.” A golden figure descended with a scale.

“Golden Law!” Empress Hong Tian and the others didn’t expect to see him.

“Why is Golden Law with them?” Origin Heaven Emperor murmured.

They were familiar with this noble ally. Golden Law had saved them more than once, famous for being principled. They knew that once he was strong enough, he would try to replace the high heaven with his laws.

“Old man, what are you doing?” Li Baye shook his head.

When Li Baye had tried to spread his dao, Golden World was the first to support him.

“You wouldn’t bet on me losing, right?” Li Qiye smiled, not surprised at all.

“No, I am the opposite of them. If I have to place a bet, I will bet on your victory.” Golden Law smiled.

“What?” Phoenix Queen and the others became confused.

“You went to the future, what did you see? That’s why you are inferior to him, he hasn’t been to the future yet still predicted accurately.” Li Qiye told Genesis.

“I don’t need to see everything clearly, only a single scene, one enough to leverage everything.” Genesis said.

Despite having gone to the future, it didn’t mean he saw everything clearly. Li Qiye and the higher beings were superior so he couldn’t glimpse their destinies. However, he saw a certain scene in the future so as long as he could move events toward this scene, he would be the final victory.

“Unfortunately, you set nothing in motion.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“We’ll just have to wait and see.” Genesis was confident.
